correctness.rationale: Differentiating the stated ordered-distinct triad force produces off-diagonal Jacobian J_ij=σs_is_j/(n-1)+2δ s_j(S-s_i-s_j)/((n-1)(n-2)), with neutral row sums. The p−1, q−1 and relative cluster eigenvalues together with rigid rotation exhaust n dimensions; excluding λ_- when q=1 is essential. Signs give stability precisely for S²>n, δ>δ_lo and, if n<S²<n+S, δ<δ_hi. For n=7,p=5,q=2, δ_lo=35σ/18 and δ_hi=15σ/2; binomial orbit counts at 2σ and 8σ are 29 and 8. Independently reconstructed exact rational signs for n=3..14 with multiple rational gains confirmed all boundaries and 21-orbit drop. Equality remains nonhyperbolic, without claim of nonlinear stability.
